name: Model Serving and Deployment
outcome: Expose an existing ML/DL model through a reproducible service.
description: Package an existing model behind a reproducible inference interface or service. Validate request and response behaviour, document configuration and manage basic deployment and access. Advanced infrastructure and model training are outside scope. The standard exercise serves a conventional ML/DL model; an LLM-serving variant additionally requires local LLM inference experience.
external: Python, Linux/CLI, HTTP APIs, containers and dependency management. For LLM serving, local LLM inference competency is additionally required.
prior: HTTP APIs, containers and dependency management
learn: Expose an existing model through an inference service
Validate inputs and outputs and configure basic access
Package and test the service reproducibly
moduleDescriptions: Define a prediction endpoint with validated input and output contracts.
Load a trusted fixed model once and check preprocessing consistency.
Package the service locally, configure access and restrict exposed resources.
Test health, prediction and failure paths; record runtime and model versions.
prerequisiteRationale: M02 supplies model suitability evidence. M03 additionally supplies local LLM runtime experience only for the optional LLM-serving variant.
